steps.en: Drop the repo into your AI editor's skills directory
steps.zh: 把仓库放进 AI 编辑器的 skills 目录

steps.en: Say what you want in plain language — footage, narration, subtitles, music
steps.zh: 用自然语言说清要什么——素材、旁白、字幕、配乐
steps.code: 帮我随便剪一个视频看看效果

steps.en: Writes a Python script into your project root that imports the wrapper
steps.zh: 在你项目根目录写一个 Python 脚本，导入那个封装

steps.en: Lays media, TTS voiceover, subtitles and music onto tracks and saves a real 剪映 draft
steps.zh: 把素材、配音、字幕、配乐铺到轨道上，存成真实剪映草稿

steps.en: Open 剪映专业版 and render the assembled timeline there
steps.zh: 打开剪映专业版，检查时间轴并在剪映里导出

value.en: A multi-track 剪映 timeline assembled from one sentence, with subtitles and voiceover already aligned
value.zh: 一句话换来一条搭好的多轨剪映时间轴，字幕和配音已经对齐

sources: README.md Quick Start: `git clone https://github.com/luoluoluo22/jianying-editor-skill.git .claude/skills/jianying-editor` (also .agent/skills, .trae/skills, skills/ variants)
README.md 试试这样跟 AI 说: 「帮我随便剪一个视频看看效果」
README.md 平台支持状态: 草稿生成支持 Windows 与 macOS 桌面版；自动导出依赖 Windows UI Automation，在剪映 5.9 或更低版本上最稳；macOS 需在剪映里手动导出
README.md 做不到什么: 最终渲染仍靠剪映本身；不能调用剪映的实时特效
rules/setup.md Recommended Bootstrap (Mandatory): `from jy_wrapper import JyProject`
rules/core.md Saving: `project.save()` is mandatory and refreshes the draft on disk
examples/my_first_vlog.py: JyProject(project_name=..., overwrite=True) then add_media_safe / add_audio_safe / add_text_simple then project.save()
